title: Fix blob upload 403 authorization error when posting listings

requirements.text: Fix the '403 - Owner does not have an account with the cashier' error that prevents users from uploading images when creating listings in the vide dressing section

quotes: Failed to upload blob tree: 403 - Owner does not have an account with the cashier: wjzpb-siaaa-aaaae-admga-cai

acceptanceCriteria: Users can successfully upload images when creating listings without receiving a 403 error
The blob storage authorization properly recognizes authenticated users
Listing creation completes successfully with uploaded images

requirements.text: Ensure the blob storage actor properly initializes and authorizes the main canister to store user-uploaded images
acceptanceCriteria: The main canister is registered as an authorized owner in the blob storage cashier
Image uploads from authenticated users succeed consistently
No authorization errors occur during the upload flow

constraints: The fix must work within the existing single-actor architecture
Do not modify the frontend image upload logic unless the backend authorization pattern requires frontend changes
Preserve existing blob storage functionality for other features
nonGoals: Redesigning the entire blob storage system
Changing the frontend UI for listing creation
